purpose: Asset-by-asset conditional economic references for objectively testable maturity transitions. These are not forecasts, seller asks, market values, investment returns or guarantees.

methodology.rule: Only R→P and P→V maturity transitions receive a numeric conditional reference. V-stage assets receive NOT_ESTABLISHED unless new attributable market/income evidence supports a separate model. An independently owned asset without its own monetary inputs has no numeric sensitivity until those inputs are established.
methodology.calculation: Recompute the published market, income, strategic and triangulated reference using the target-stage factors from economic-methodology.json while holding invariant inputs constant.
methodology.interpretation: A maturity-only sensitivity. It answers what the published model would output if the stated maturity gate were independently evidenced, with all other inputs unchanged.

externalStandards.title: International Valuation Standards
externalStandards.relevance: Valuation approaches, data and inputs, models, documentation and reporting for valuation practice, including intangible assets.

externalStandards.title: Valuing in the Absence of Markets
externalStandards.relevance: Transparency of process and inputs is especially important where market inputs are limited or non-observable.

methodology.boundary: No TAM-derived value, speculative revenue, arbitrary probability, automatic multiple, future seller ask or unverified commercialization outcome is used.

latestIdentityUpdate.boundary: Each new software project is counted once. The confirmed repository rename retains its existing project identifier and reference alias. Withdrawn identifiers are not reused.

previousIdentityUpdate.boundary: Remaining project identifiers and identities are preserved; withdrawn identifiers are not reused.

currentPortfolio.monetaryScope: 104 independent software IP assets with individual seller asking references and defined existing-scope recreation estimates. Four new prototypes and two implemented increments have updated estimates; the other 98 existing prices are retained. Website repositories are excluded.

latestPortfolioScopeUpdate.boundary: All 117 repositories and 36 open pull requests were compared with the preceding portfolio. The 104 active software assets are independently scoped; 13 publication repositories are excluded. Nine pinned source trees from seven projects were byte-verified and locally tested. Current-main, unmerged development, historical validation and future specifications remain separate. The current video prototype passes its mandatory 73-test/build gate; the earlier blocker is resolved. Remote perception retains an explicitly blocked commercial transfer gate. CRE and the mission framework retain open rights/delivery conditions. No physical, anomalous-perception, independently certified rights/security, production hosting or future scientific capability is established by local tests.
